selection: For each candidate: mean source-unit val RMSE over both dev seeds; missing/timeout is ineligible. Rank cases by CGB relative to best completed original-native linear neighbor (PL/LGB_linear) and Lin, preserve every failure/control. At most 2 finalists; prefer a real task with directional improvement and a distinct synthetic mechanism. Full 20 unique configs/method before confirmation; no claims from quick-screen timings.
timing: Concurrent discovery times diagnostic only; final timing exclusive same-host single-thread repetitions.
disclosure: Exploratory case selection, two new real sources plus two same-source new targets; real repetitions may share held-out test. No benchmark-population win-rate claim.
